hypothesis: Host checks reproduce the compiler product, resource encoding and tiled GEMM algorithm for local memory.
narrative: checks/gpu-local.py checks the real compiler product, reproduces its tracked descriptor, refuses malformed metadata and compares every supported common-store allocation with the pinned Mesa CDM generator. The OpenCL source compiled for the host runs on 32 threads sharing its local arrays with a pthread barrier; cases cover full tiles, partial tiles, zero depth, negative operands, repeated local reuse and changing input, require every lane to reach the expected barrier count and every output location one write. Compiler figures of the tiled GEMM: 2,800 USC code bytes, twenty temporaries, 99 coefficients, indexed cf3 accesses for local data. Resource figures: 96 local words (384 bytes) plus 3 system words reserve seven 64-byte units (448 bytes); limit 240 local words (960 bytes) with seven system words is sixteen units (1,024 bytes); the CDM encoding allows 256 units (4,096 words). Test result is 48 little-endian bytes: completed jobs, M, N, K, last checksum, last sequence, local bytes, checked guard words, four kick_to_done_us values.
